title: Sour Canadian Noodle Soup
description: A hearty, sour, and energizing vegan noodle dish that combines the best of Canadian flavors with a bold twist.
instructions: Bring the vegan broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the gluten-free noodles and cook for 8 minutes, or until al dente.
Meanwhile, heat the sesame oil in a pan and sauté the grated ginger for 1 minute.
Add the vegan dumplings to the pan and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and soy sauce, then add the chopped green onions.
Once the noodles are cooked, add them to the pan with the ginger and dumplings.
Stir in the lemon juice and soy sauce mixture, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the Sour Canadian Noodle Soup hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
